narrative:
Medina County has 132,106 registered voters, with 21.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 29.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 40.9%, a clear Democratic lean of 11.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.3% of registrants.
